root_cause: tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py passes gen_answer_fn=genai_gen_text to wwb.Evaluator(...) and then calls evaluator.score(target_model, evaluator.get_generation_fn()). whowhatbench is installed unpinned from `git+https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino.genai.git#subdirectory=tools/who_what_benchmark` (tests/llm/requirements.txt), so the version resolved at install time has a TextEvaluator._generate_data() that calls gen_answer_fn(..., context=...), while the installed genai_gen_text() signature does not accept a 'context' keyword argument. This is a cross-repo API mismatch between openvino's test harness and the current HEAD of openvino.genai's who_what_benchmark package, not a regression caused by PR #39512 (which only edits a benchmarks CSV data file unrelated to tests/llm). The identical signature was already recorded once before (run 41968975027, also against PR #39512) and has now recurred, confirming this is a persistent, unpinned-dependency drift issue rather something introduced by this specific PR.
reproduction_steps:
1. pip install -r tests/llm/requirements.txt (pulls whowhatbench at the current openvino.genai HEAD).
2. cd tests/llm && python3 -m pytest accuracy_conformance.py -k CPU --tb native --log-cli-level ERROR
3. Observe TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context' raised from whowhatbench/text_evaluator.py inside _generate_data().
recommended_actions: Pin whowhatbench to a specific commit/tag of openvino.genai in tests/llm/requirements.txt that is known-compatible with the genai_gen_text(...) call signature used in accuracy_conformance.py, instead of tracking the unpinned git HEAD.

Update tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py (or whowhatbench's genai_gen_text) so the 'context' keyword argument is accepted/forwarded consistently on both sides of the openvino / openvino.genai repo boundary.

Add a CI smoke check that imports whowhatbench and introspects genai_gen_text's signature right after installing tests/llm/requirements.txt, failing fast with a clear message before the full accuracy suite runs.
prevention_strategies: Avoid installing cross-repo test dependencies (whowhatbench) from an unpinned git ref in CI; pin to a tagged/commit-pinned version and bump it deliberately in lockstep with any call-signature changes to gen_answer_fn/genai_gen_text. Add a contract/unit test that calls evaluator.get_generation_fn()/genai_gen_text with the exact kwargs accuracy_conformance.py uses, so signature drift is caught before the full LLM accuracy suite is invoked in the merge queue.
historical_context: This is the 2nd recorded occurrence of this exact signature (signature_hash 6cf9cf0d8f5c0a43), first seen on run 41968975027 (2026-11-05T06:17:40Z), also associated with PR #39512. Both occurrences point to the same whowhatbench/openvino.genai version-drift root cause rather than anything introduced by the PR's CSV-only change.
